rationale: All four registered questions now carry decided accounts with complete comparison sets, so the last useful action is to make the parent finding's measured effect durable in the same form as the other two findings: a behavior entry citing the receipts that decided it. Nothing in the accounts changes, no question is reopened and no experiment is requested; the remaining unmeasured ground (production store implementations, horizons beyond ten seconds, and the child questions' own bounds) stays recorded as limitation inside the parent interpretation.

knowledge.statement: A follower that accepts an InstallSnapshot whose index does not exceed its cached last log entry never accepts another log entry from that leader: the cached claim keeps outranking the installed snapshot in getLastEntry, every prev-log check fails, the leader walks nextIndex down until it can no longer read its own trimmed log, and it re-ships the same snapshot. Measured at three and five voters and over three-, four- and ten-second windows: the follower's FSM was restored repeatedly (4 -> 1193 in three seconds, 5 -> 4788 in ten) while its applied index stayed at the snapshot index and the cluster frontier advanced (83 -> 95 in three seconds, 83 -> 123 in ten); its commit index stayed 0 and the cached claim persisted above the snapshot index. With a monotonic log store the store was emptied (first and last index 0) while the claim persisted unchanged, and publishing a snapshot above the claim (index 98 against a claim of 97) restored the follower to the frontier.
knowledge.conditions: In-process stores (InmemStore, FileSnapshotStore and its monotonic wrapper) with TrailingLogs=10 against a large-trailing control, one induced partition of a single voter that holds an uncommitted suffix from a superseded leader, its restart on the unchanged stores, an idle cluster with one client write per 250 ms sample and no automatic snapshotting, three or five voters, and the leader's snapshot index remaining at or below the follower's cached claim throughout the window.
